title: Transfer, Adjacency, Confidence & Unknown-State Rules
objective: Define bounded visibility-safe advisory transfer eligibility, adjacency, confidence and unknown-state rules over completed KFR vocabulary, topology and explicit records without creating familiarity, competence, permission, qualification or canonical owner state.

runner_blocker_history.resolution: Owner reported governed self-hosted runners restored; the temporary KFR-04 hosted detour was removed and exact-head self-hosted execution resumed.

red.failure: Self-hosted selector/preflight executed. Linux and Windows then failed at client-typecheck on only the intentionally missing KFR-04 transfer/confidence contract and accessible panel plus cascading missing-type diagnostics.

resolved_contract.transfer_rule: A visible explicit KFR-04 rule may classify an advisory transfer candidate only when the referenced visible KFR-02 graph relation matches and the source KFR-03 record is visible or genuinely absent; adjacency alone never creates eligibility or familiarity.
resolved_contract.unknown_rule: Explicit-unknown source records remain explicit unknown. Missing source records remain absent. Both remain unknown for advisory transfer eligibility and neither is rewritten into familiarity or competence.
resolved_contract.confidence_rule: Confidence is categorical rule evidence, never a computed proficiency percentage; incompatible resolves ineligible.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized rules, source records and relation inputs are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.authority_rule: Canonical Character, Progression/Skill, owner-domain and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative. KFR-04 writes no target knowledge, familiarity or progression state.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-04 persistence or duplicate transfer ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Accessible nonvisual advisory eligibility, source-state, confidence and authority equivalents implemented.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-03 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
No automatic transfer, target familiarity record, competence grant, proficiency/certification/permission/ownership/action authority or operator qualification was introduced.
No canonical mutation, durable KFR-04 persistence or migration 0022 was introduced.
KFR-05 is successor selection only; KFR-06+, ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
